The abstract frames the work as RAG-related: it targets context assembly for the prompt window, reports token consumption per query, and runs benchmarks and simulations. It proposes a retrieval and truth-maintenance framework over knowledge hypergraphs, with experiments. Whether a generator actually conditions on the retrieved text is not clearly stated, since the metrics are mostly retrieval fidelity, latency, and tokens. Still, it is framed as RAG with context assembly for prompts and runs experiments, so it leans toward inclusion.
